name: handholder
title_zh: ADB 直连掌机，换机迁移不丢存档不重配按键
tagline_zh: 新掌机到手最怕重设模拟器、丢通关存档。它直接走 ADB 接管 Cocoon、RetroArch 热键着色器。
tagline_en: Tired of reconfiguring emulators and losing saves on a new handheld? This drives ADB to handle Cocoon, RetroArch.
desc_en: Set up, migrate, repair, or audit Android gaming handhelds over ADB, including Cocoon, emulators, RetroArch hotkeys and shaders, replacement textures, lawful ROM and save migration, artwork, controls, displays, and launch testing. Includes profiles for AYN Thor and Retroid Pocket Nova; use the generic workflow for other Android handhelds.
why_zh: 不是给模拟器套壳，而是用 ADB 直接读写设备分区，迁移合法 ROM 和存档时保留原始目录结构。
why_en: It talks ADB directly to the device, preserving original folder structure for lawful ROM/save migration, and archives.
limit_zh: 仅限 Android 掌机且需本机 ADB 环境；不含 iOS/Windows 设备、不代找 BIOS。
limit_en: Android handhelds only, requires local ADB. No iOS/Windows, no BIOS sourcing, ROM legality on you. Stops at detection if out of scope.
title_en: ADB-based Android handheld setup, migration, repair, and.
